display.purpose: The net worth figure, page titles, landing hook. Always tabular-lining for figures.

body.purpose: All running text and UI copy.

label.purpose: Kickers (vermilion), card labels (ink 60%), table headers. 0.12em tracked uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: a lifted second sheet under dialogs, popovers, tooltips. No blur shadows anywhere (The Flat Print Rule).

motion.name: ridge-draw
motion.purpose: The one authored moment per surface: the landing ridgeline draws itself on arrival. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Indigo printed plate; nothing moves on hover, the ink just deepens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #1e3a5f); color: var(--primary-foreground, #f6f1e6); padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1e3a5f) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1e3a5f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #1e3a5f); padding: 12px 28px; border: 1.5px solid var(--primary, #1e3a5f); border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1e3a5f) 8%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1e3a5f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Vermilion outline that floods on hover — a stamp poised to strike.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: transparent; color: var(--destructive, #c73a2b); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--destructive, #c73a2b); border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: var(--destructive, #c73a2b); color: var(--background, #f6f1e6); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A washi sheet laid on the paper; the leading card earns an indigo border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #fcfaf4); color: var(--card-foreground, #3b2f2a); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9ccae); border-radius: 6px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.6; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-figure { font-family: 'Shippori Mincho B1', Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; }

components.name: Delta Chip
components.description: Gain/loss chips: outlined in their own ink, always sign + arrow + value.
components.html: ▲ +2.4% vs last month ▼ −1.1% vs Jan 1
components.css: .ds-chip-gain, .ds-chip-loss { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; } .ds-chip-gain { color: var(--gain, #47684f); } .ds-chip-loss { color: var(--loss, #b13223); }

components.name: Number Chip
components.description: The contents-map compartment marker: vermilion circle, paper numeral.
components.css: .ds-number-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--seal, #c73a2b); color: var(--background, #f6f1e6); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A ruled field on the sheet; focus inks the rule indigo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; background: var(--card, #fcfaf4); color: var(--foreground, #3b2f2a); border: 1px solid var(--input, #cbbb96); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #6f5f4d); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border: 1.5px solid var(--primary, #1e3a5f); }

components.name: Section Kicker
components.description: The wrapper grammar: vermilion tracked caps with a dotted leader running to the edge.
components.html: What's in the box
components.css: .ds-kicker-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-kicker { color: var(--seal, #c73a2b); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-kicker-rule { flex: 1; height: 2px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal, #c73a2b) 55%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 8px 2px; background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: center; }

components.name: Privacy Stamp
components.description: An outlined vermilion stamp, slightly askew like a real impression.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal, #c73a2b) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--seal, #c73a2b); padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-2deg); }

narrative.overview: BitWorth is designed as an honestly-mapped box in the ekiben-wrapper tradition: warm paper grounds, one deep ink that draws everything, vermilion seals that certify rather than decorate, and a numbered diagram whose promise is that everything is exactly where the wrapper says it is. The product's privacy stance (you enter every number yourself) becomes the world's honesty stance: the map is always true, absences stay visible, nothing is invented. The system is a print world, not a screen world wearing print clothes. Illustration is woodblock-flavored ink line art, always; photography, never. The canonical rendition is paper-light; dark mode is the same print run at night — the ink plate itself, cream type on deep indigo-black, seals still vermilion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds with visible texture; flat, outlined surfaces; no glow, no glass, no gradient chrome
One ink (indigo/ink brown) for type, borders, and illustration alike
Vermilion reserved for seals, numbered markers, section kickers, and negative amounts
Numbers are the heroes, set in a carved Mincho display face
Empty states are honest absence: dotted outlines and plain words

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion behaves like a rubber stamp: small, saturated, certifying. If a vermilion element is wider than a thumb, it has stopped being a seal.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Illustration, borders, and type share the same ink colors. Nothing is ever gray-on-gray; muted content tints toward kraft, not gray.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Cargo Rule
rules.body: Financial figures always render tabular-lining; a figure and its currency never break across lines; deltas always carry sign, arrow, and percentage.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: No blur shadows, no glow, no glass. If an element needs separation, give it an outline or a different paper tone; if it truly floats, give it the hard paper offset.

dos: Do set every financial figure in tabular lining numerals with its currency attached.
Do draw icons and illustration as single-ink line art (1.5–2px stroke, indigo or current ink).
Do keep the paper texture subtle — felt at rest, invisible while reading.
Do pair every color-coded meaning (sage gain, vermilion loss) with a glyph or word.
Do keep dark mode a true night print: same layout, ink plate grounds, cream type, vermilion seals unchanged.
donts: Don't use photography, glow, glass/blur decoration, or gradient fills anywhere.
Don't use blur shadows; floating layers use the hard paper offset (The Flat Print Rule).
Don't let vermilion carry large fills or body text (The Seal Rule).
Don't use gray; muted content tints kraft/ink (The One Ink Rule).
Don't bridge gaps in charts or invent placeholder data; absence renders as honest absence.
